name: Mozambique (People's Republic of Mozambique, then Republic of Mozambique)

predecessors.name: Portuguese Mozambique
predecessors.text: 'Mozambique became independent from Portugal on 25 June 1975.'

ledger.x: 25 June 1975: Mozambique becomes independent from Portugal as the People's Republic of Mozambique.
30 May 1977: the Mozambican Civil War begins.
30 November 1990: the People's Republic of Mozambique ends.
4 October 1992: the Rome General Peace Accords end the civil war.

wars.name: Mozambican Civil War
wars.outcome: Ended by the Rome General Peace Accords of 4 October 1992 (effective 15 October); no border changed and RENAMO's proposal of secession 'of RENAMO-controlled northern and western territories' was not taken up.

wars.name: Cabo Delgado insurgency
wars.outcome: Ongoing at the end of the dossier: the Mozambique page records 'the outbreak of a violent insurgency in the northern province of Cabo Delgado beginning in October 2017' and says nothing of ground held.

certainty.note: Judgement, not read in the pages opened: the frontiers are colonial treaty lines inherited at independence and no border dispute is recorded on the Mozambique page ('the page mentions no border dispute' with Malawi or Tanzania).
